steps.content:
The error indicates that `uint8_t` is not recognized, which suggests that the necessary header for it is missing. To fix this, include the `<stdint.h>` header at the top of `harness_fuzz.c`.

ACTION: edit_file
```json
{
  "path": "harness_fuzz.c",
  "search": "",
  "replace": "#include \"src/ini.h\"\n#include <stdint.h>\n\nint LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size) {\n    char out[64];\n    ini_get((const char*)data, size, \"a.b\", out, sizeof(out));\n    ini_count((const char*)data, size);\n    return 0;\n}\n"
}
```
